confirmedFindings.title: Buffer Allocation in Loop During Packet Loss
confirmedFindings.body: Allocating a new Buffer in a tight loop during packet loss bursts generates immense garbage collection heap churn (thousands of short-lived buffers/sec per stream), increasing event-loop latency.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Reuse a shared static or pooled Buffer instance for synthetic concealment frames.
